summary: Shasta County enclosed tower on Sims Peak: a 1931 newspaper item reports the station completed, keepers into the 1960s, and it is listed as gone with no removal date found.

facts.design: Enclosed tower (Forest Fire Lookout Association type)

visit.trail_note: No standing lookout to visit. The Sims Flat Forest Service campground is near Castella, reached from Sims Road

notes_for_editor: Built date conflict, unresolved: the July 1931 Searchlight item (quoted on the Forest Lookouts page) says the new Sims Peak station was completed; the Hmdb CCC marker says the Sims camp crew built three lookouts including Sims and that the camp lasted six years. Sources do not say whether the crew rebuilt an older station. Location: the record point (41.04302, -122.36142) lies roughly 2 km south of the Sims Flat marker (41 3.664 N, 122 21.634 W); the peak site itself was not verified. Agency: the record says Shasta National Forest, which is the name used in the 1931-1962 clippings. The Forest Service Sims Flat page sits under the Shasta-Trinity National Forest; the sources do not say which unit administers the peak today. Consider a correction once confirmed. No removal date found. The Living New Deal Sims CCC camp page returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Two web searches used.
